title: H 指数 II
summary: 在引用次数已按升序排列时，用对数复杂度求 H 指数。
insight: 寻找最左的下标 index，使 citations[index] 至少为 n-index；答案为其右侧论文数量。
pitfalls: 右边界可取 n 表示没有满足项
条件满足时继续向左寻找

solutions.title: 二分最左满足位置
solutions.idea: 对单调条件 citations[index]>=n-index 做 lower bound。

code.java: class Solution { public int hIndex(int[] citations){int left=0,right=citations.length;while(left<right){int middle=left+(right-left)/2;if(citations[middle]>=citations.length-middle)right=middle;else left=middle+1;}return citations.length-left;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun hIndex(citations:IntArray):Int{var left=0;var right=citations.size;while(left<right){val middle=left+(right-left)/2;if(citations[middle]>=citations.size-middle)right=middle else left=middle+1};return citations.size-left} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int hIndex(vector<int>& citations){int left=0,right=citations.size();while(left<right){int middle=left+(right-left)/2;if(citations[middle]>=(int)citations.size()-middle)right=middle;else left=middle+1;}return citations.size()-left;} };
